name: intro
arrangement: Sparse upright piano arpeggios layered with delicate fingerpicked acoustic guitar in drop-D tuning, leaving deliberate breath and silence between chords.

name: verse_1
arrangement: Upright piano root notes sustained quietly under muted acoustic guitar eighth notes. Soft kick drum on beats 1 and 3, dry wooden rim clicks on 2 and 4, anchored by a warm, round electric bass.

name: pre_1
arrangement: Drums enter with soft eighth-note closed hi-hats. Bass walks up stepwise through inversions while a warm analog synth pad gradually swells under the acoustic guitar.

name: chorus_1
arrangement: Full rhythm section enters: open acoustic strumming, dry vintage snare, melodic bass following the kick pattern, and a clean electric guitar line with light tape chorus doubling the hook contour.

name: turnaround
arrangement: Drums pull back to rim click and kick. Electric guitar restates the core two-bar melodic motif over sustained piano and melodic bass fills.

name: verse_2
arrangement: Kick, rim click, and active bass re-enter immediately to maintain story tempo, supported by dry muted electric guitar chops accentuating the off-beats.

name: pre_2
arrangement: Snare shifts from rim click to ghosted center hits; floor tom pulses on beats 2 and 4, while doubled acoustic guitars lead an ascending harmonic build.

name: chorus_2
arrangement: Full organic groove returns with wider stereo acoustic guitars, active melodic bass counterpoint, and high-register guitar fills answering vocal cadences.

name: bridge
arrangement: Sudden drop in instrumentation shifting to a Neapolitan Cmaj7 color; drums strip down to subtle ride cymbal washes and felt mallets, framing close-mic vocal intimacy.

name: final_chorus
arrangement: Dynamic peak with thick acoustic strumming, punchy live kit, driving bass lines, ambient guitar swells, and tight doubled vocal unison on the central hook line.
chords: Bm - Gmaj7 - D - A - Bm - Gmaj7 - Em7 - F#7

name: outro
arrangement: Rhythm section recedes into natural room reverb decay. Upright piano and fingerpicked guitar resolve slowly over a sustained low B pedal tone, fading on a suspended Bmadd9.
